neighbours.label: ' recommended' / ' preferred' and close synonyms as an attributive marking the endorsed option or level (recommended levels, the preferred method); not 'necessary' / 'need', which is the - pole
fire: Salt intake in the region is nearly double the recommended amount.
Bank transfer remains the preferred method of payment for most customers.
Keep the tyres inflated to the recommended pressure shown in the manual.
For this recipe, butter is the preferred fat, though oil will do.
Children should not exceed the recommended dose printed on the label.
Among local cyclists, the canal path is the preferred route into town.
The engine ran hotter than the recommended temperature for an hour.
Pine was once the preferred timber for building these boats.
quiet: Salt intake in the region is nearly double the national average.
Bank transfer remains the slowest method of payment for most customers.
Keep the tyres inflated and check the pressure once a month.
For this recipe, it is not necessary to melt the butter first.
Children need a smaller dose than the one printed for adults.
Among local cyclists, the canal path is the oldest route into town.
The engine ran hotter than usual for about an hour.
Pine was once the cheapest timber for building these boats.

notes: Card: ' preferred' x2, ' recommended' x2, ' sustainable' levels, ' right', 必須, 最適, 적합; + pole's output suppresses ' appropriate', ' necessary', ' best', ' optimal'. Probe: recommended 0.72, preferred 0.65, ideal 0.32, essential 0.34; 'not necessary' 0.00, 'last year's levels' 0.11, 'sustainable limits' 0.09.
